propositions: a keyless-pending binding formed by crash during create_issue remains pending after a single negative jql search, allowing a duplicate create to occur when the index eventually catches up
recover_pending's keyless branch unbinds after a single search miss even though the issue may exist but be unindexed, removing the record that would gate the duplicate create
create_one's jql dedup search misses an unindexed issue and creates a duplicate because the keyless-pending binding was already unbound
the create gate in outbound_differ consults only get_jira_key() and does not check is_pending(), so a keyless-pending entry cannot suppress a duplicate create
once search_miss_count reaches 3 and entry age exceeds the grace window, unbinding occurs; until then the pending entry remains and the next pass retries
the fix requires both leaving the binding pending (site 1, recover_pending) and gating the create on pendingness (site 2, create_one), because fixing only site 1 still allows the duplicate at site 2
